name: Zythar
tactics: A zythar hovers above the battlefield, laying down abyssal flamebursts to contain its foes. It concentrates tendrils of flame and flame bolt against opponents at the edge of the fray, using fiery slam to stay away from enemies that close for melee. A zythar drops to the ground and fights with renewed vigor once bloodied, knowing that curse of the balor will create a lasting reminder of its fury.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Flame Sphere
traits.details: Any creature that ends its turn within the aura takes 10 fire damage.

traits.name: Evasive Haze
traits.details: The zythar gains a +2 bonus to all defenses against ranged attacks.

auras.name: Flame Sphere

fire damage, and ongoing 10 fire damage (save ends).

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature taking ongoing fire damage

hit.description: fire damage, and the ongoing fire damage taken by the target increases by 5. In addition, the target loses any fire resistance until it saves against the ongoing fire damage.

effect.description: The zythar creates a zone in an area burst 2 within 20 squares that lasts until the end of the zythar’s next turn. Any creature that enters the zone or ends its turn there takes 25 fire damage. The zone blocks line of sight.

powers.name: Curse of the Balor
powers.trigger: The zythar drops to 0 hit points.

effect.description: The zythar explodes, creating a zone in a close burst 1 that lasts until the end of the encounter. Any creature that starts its turn within the zone takes 10 fire damage.

powers.name: Variable Resistance
powers.trigger: The zythar takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

effect.description: The zythar gains resist 15 to the triggering damage type until the end of the encounter or until it uses variable resistance again.
